groups.description: crash between the reservation and the task record
groups.fault: SIGKILL after the creation index is written, before task.json
groups.injection_note: the crash harness kills the native store writer the daemon spawns with SIGKILL at the first creation-index write (the reservation), once before and once after it is acknowledged, and repeats the creation through the running daemon

groups.description: retry after the daemon process exited
groups.fault: kill the daemon, restart, repeat the same creation key
groups.injection_note: the crash harness kills the native store writer the daemon spawns with SIGKILL at the task-record write, once before and once after it is acknowledged, and repeats the creation through the running daemon; the daemon itself is not killed or restarted, although the description and fault fields say it is
groups.design_departure: the run does not kill the daemon or restart it: it kills the native store writer the daemon spawns, at the task-record write, and repeats the creation through the running daemon
groups.product_path_owner: #36 converts it: the crash harness kills the built daemon and restarts it before the same creation key is repeated; the run builds the daemon, so no other record has to land first

groups.description: session meta written, transcript header lost
groups.fault: SIGKILL between the transcript header and the meta write
groups.injection_note: the crash harness kills the native store writer the daemon spawns with SIGKILL at the second creation-index write (the activation), once before and once after it is acknowledged, and repeats the creation through the running daemon; no session transcript or meta write is involved, although the description and fault fields describe one
groups.design_departure: the run writes no session transcript header or meta, so no kill falls between them: it kills the native store writer at the second creation-index write (the activation)
groups.product_path_owner: #36 converts it: a kill point between the built daemon's session transcript-header write and its meta write (`sessionStore.create` writes the header, then the meta, through `autosk-store-lock`); the run builds the daemon, so no other record has to land first

groups.description: resume under a changed runtime identity
groups.fault: swap the installed distribution between enroll and resume
groups.injection_note: the identity harness swaps the installed distribution on disk and resumes the task through the daemon

groups.description: symlinked project subdirectory

groups.description: restore returns the branch name but the wrong tree
groups.fault: restore a branch pointing at a different tree OID
groups.injection_note: no restore runs: a later commit supplies the other tree; the tree OID is measured, the oid it is handed is the base commit read before the fault, and the rest of the observation is written
groups.design_departure: no restore runs: a later commit supplies the other tree, and the observation the guard is handed is written but for the tree OID
groups.product_path_owner: #36 converts it: a restore that lands on another tree, met by the final-CAS path; needs #9's staging and final-CAS driver reached from the extension entry point (#18) first

groups.description: foreign movement of the target between check and CAS
